intro: The Storwel 2-door steel almirah is your reliable storage companion. Engineered for modern needs, it combines durability and security with timeless design to keep your belongings safe and organised.

features.title: Anti-corrosive oven baked powder coating
features.text: Built to last, its premium anti-corrosive finish ensures durability while maintaining a sleek, polished look that resists wear and tear for years.

features.title: Three-way bolting system for enhanced security
features.text: Enjoy peace of mind with its robust bolting system, which secures the doors from multiple points, keeping your valuables protected and secure.

features.title: Locker that protects your world
features.text: The spacious locker offers a dedicated, secure space for storing important documents, jewellery, or other valuables, blending safety with convenience.

features.title: Organisational features that keeps it tidy
features.text: Keep your wardrobe wrinkle-free and well-organised. The sturdy hanging rod and tie bar provide ample space for your formal and everyday clothes.

features.title: Elevated base for easy cleaning
features.text: The thoughtfully designed elevated base ensures effortless cleaning beneath the almirah, making it simple to maintain a dust-free and hygienic space.

features.title: Adjustable storage shelves for versatile storage
features.text: Adjustable shelves easily customise the space to accommodate items of varying sizes, ensuring organised, efficient, and convenient storage solutions.

name: Storwel M2 2-Door Steel Almirah Prince Grey
